claim: Yelp expanded throughout at least one continent.

evidence.text: From 2009 to 2012 , Yelp expanded throughout Europe and Asia .
A continent is one of several very large landmasses on Earth .
Yelp is an American multinational corporation headquartered in San Francisco , California .

It develops , hosts and markets Yelp.com and the Yelp mobile app , which publish crowd-sourced reviews about local businesses , as well as the online reservation service Yelp Reservations and online food-delivery service Eat24 .
Yelp was founded in 2004 by former PayPal employees Russel Simmons and Jeremy Stoppelman .
